# NormaHub AI Gateway Extension for Cursor and VS Code — Technical Specification

> Native IDE extension integrating the NormaHub OpenAI-compatible AI Gateway directly into Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, and VSCodium.

## Capabilities
- Zero-VPN Direct Connectivity: Targets `https://api.normahub.cc/v1` with 35-45ms latency for CIS developers.
- Supported Models: Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, Claude Opus 5.
- SecretStorage: API key stored in secure OS Keychain/SecretService, preventing plaintext exposure in `.vscode/settings.json`.
- Automatic Config Scaffolding:
  - Generates `.cursorrules` and `.cursor/rules/normahub.mdc`
  - Generates `.windsurfrules`
  - Generates `.aider.conf.yml`
  - Generates `cline_custom_modes.json` and `.clinerules`
- Built-in Streaming AI Playground: Measures Time To First Token (TTFT) and real-time generation speed.

## VSIX Artifact
- Filename: `normahub-ai-gateway-1.1.0.vsix`
- Installation: `cursor --install-extension normahub-ai-gateway-1.1.0.vsix`
